prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1477; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has suffered physical injuries that are still being evaluated, and we ask that you respect this request while the claim is under review.

To allow us to assess the claim properly, please provide the declarations page and the full policy limits for each coverage that may apply, including bodily injury liability and any medical payments coverage. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence related to the incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, telematics data, and any communications with the other parties involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until the claim is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
